'''Flaz'arrir''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] residing aboard the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], where he shared his knowledge of scavenging with others.<ref name="TOR" />
